robot: Franka Emika Panda arm with the Franka Hand parallel gripper on a fixed base, driven by EmbodiedSWE's operational-space (torque) controller

frame.suite: the simulator's world frame (metres, z up)
frame.base_text: the arm's base (panda_link0), at world (0, -0.58, 0.858) and turned 90 degrees about z: +X forward (world +y), +Y left (world -x), +Z up

arm.note: end-effector pose = the panda_hand frame; joint_positions = the two finger position targets (m each, 0 closed, 0.04 open)

ee.point: the panda_hand frame (the hand's flange); the point midway between the fingertips is 0.1034 m further along the hand's own +Z (approach) axis
ee.mode_text: a streamed pose target that the operational-space controller tracks; move_robot interpolates the path at about 0.15 m/s

notes: The arm takes end-effector poses only, tracked by EmbodiedSWE's operational-space (torque) controller; its seven joints take no direct command. The end-effector pose is the panda_hand frame, not the fingertips: the point midway between the fingertips is 0.1034 m along the hand's own +Z (approach) axis from it, so for a top-down grasp put panda_hand 0.1034 m above the grasp point. The arm's two joint_positions are the finger position targets (finger_1, finger_2, metres each: 0 = closed, 0.04 = open): send both together, e.g. [0.04, 0.04] to open and [0.0, 0.0] to close; a closed target on an object squeezes it. gripper_opening_m in the state is the measured distance between the finger pads (about 0.08 fully open). The measured joint angles are in observe's proprio_now (its layout: describe_robot's spec_file, proprio_layout). One episode, no reset; it ends by itself once the task is complete.
